summary: Frontend E2E check of R-Conekta branding and the P5 flow, using two browser contexts: an anonymous follower on mobile and a logged-in partner on desktop. Everything passed once the frontend was restarted. Before the restart, the CRA dev server was serving an old index.html (title 'RRclub · Luxury Experiences', no favicon link), even though public/index.html had been changed at 14:11. After 'supervisorctl restart frontend': document.title = 'R-Conekta | RRClub', the favicon link /r-conekta-icon.svg returns 200 image/svg+xml, manifest short_name = 'R-Conekta', and brand-logo/sidebar-logo show 'R-Conekta / BY RRCLUB'. P5 flow (run twice, each with a new session): /c/P5E2E-01 creates a session and shows a QR with p5_ref (35 chars). Partner pastes the QR URL, POST /api/partner/p5/scans returns 200 {status:'scanned'} and p5-qr-state turns emerald. The follower then shows only the waiting text with no pay button (a scan is not treated as payment). Amount 40.00, then approve: POST /api/partner/p5/charges returns 200 with gross_minor 4000, discount_minor 200, net_minor 3800. Without a reload, the follower panel showed 40,00 € / -2,00 € / 38,00 € and an enabled p5-pay-button within 1.1-2.0s. Clicking it sends POST /api/public/p5/charges/checkout (origin_url = preview origin), which returns 200 with a checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_... URL. The browser started redirecting and I aborted the request (nothing was paid). No 4xx/5xx responses and no console errors in either context.
